COLDWAR_CYP_1970_record_GRE_response = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_crisis_active
			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_current_reply_GRE }
		}
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_current_reply_GRE
		add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_CYP_1970_current_substantive_replies = 1 }
		clamp_variable = { var = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_current_substantive_replies min = 0 max = 100 }
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_guarantor_response_recorded
	}
}

COLDWAR_CYP_1970_restore_civilian_authority = {
	set_temp_variable = { rul_party_temp = 2 }
	set_temp_variable = { disable_elections = 0 }
	change_ruling_party_effect = yes
	set_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_acting_clerides
	if = {
		limit = {
			date > 1973.12.31
			date < 1974.12.7
			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_makarios_deceased }
		}
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_makarios_return_context
	}
	COLDWAR_CYP_1970_record_restoration = yes
}

COLDWAR_CYP_1970_update_displacement_recovery = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_applied_reconstruction
			has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_restitution_implemented
			has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_final_settlement_implemented
			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_unresolved_reprisals }
		}
		remove_ideas = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_displacement_emergency
		clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_displacement_active
	}
}

			CYP = { exists = yes IMP_is_1970_scenario = yes has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_crisis_active has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_settlement_talks_open has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_reply_TUR_war_geneva check_variable = { COLDWAR_CYP_1970_offer_instance_war_geneva = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_crisis_instance } NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_final_settlement_implemented } }
		}
		CYP = {
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_talks_withdrawn_TUR
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_reply_TUR_war_geneva
			COLDWAR_CYP_1970_record_TUR_response = yes
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_geneva_failed
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_settlement_talks_open
		}
	}
}

COLDWAR_CYP_1970_relief_1 = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { COLDWAR_CYP_1970_relief_stage < 1 }
			owns_state = 145
			controls_state = 145
			owns_state = 146
			controls_state = 146
		}
		remove_ideas = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_tc_parallel_administration
		remove_ideas = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_admin_stage_1
		remove_ideas = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_admin_stage_2
		145 = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					is_owned_by = CYP
					is_controlled_by = CYP
				}
				remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_restricted_movement_south }
				remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_access_south_1 }
			}
		}
		146 = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					is_owned_by = CYP
					is_controlled_by = CYP
				}
				remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_restricted_movement_north }
				remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_access_north_1 }
				remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_access_north_2 }
			}
		}
		145 = {
			add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_access_south_1 }
		}
		146 = {
			add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_access_north_1 }
		}
		add_ideas = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_admin_stage_1
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_CYP_1970_relief_stage = 1 }
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_civilian_access_implemented
	}
}

COLDWAR_CYP_1970_sync_makarios_spirit = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { ruling_party = 1 }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_makarios_deceased }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_coup_regime_active }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_idea = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_makarios_authority }
			}
			add_ideas = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_makarios_authority
		}
	}
	else = {
		remove_ideas = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_makarios_authority
	}
}

COLDWAR_CYP_1970_grant_republic_at_ten = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_applied_republic_at_ten }
		}
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_applied_republic_at_ten
		add_political_power = 50
	}
}

COLDWAR_CYP_1970_send_republic_at_ten = {
	COLDWAR_CYP_1970_grant_republic_at_ten = yes
}

COLDWAR_CYP_1970_complete_republic_at_ten = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_registered_republic_at_ten }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_CYP_1970_current_cost = gdp_total }
		multiply_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_CYP_1970_current_cost = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = {
				original_tag = CYP
				IMP_is_1970_scenario = yes
				OR = { is_ai = no AND = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_dedicated_historical_ai NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_human_seat_reserved } } }
			}
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_registered_republic_at_ten
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_pending_completion_republic_at_ten

			COLDWAR_CYP_1970_send_republic_at_ten = yes
		}
		else = {
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_pending_completion_republic_at_ten
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_programmes_pending
		}
	}
}

COLDWAR_CYP_1970_grant_intercommunal_talks = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_applied_intercommunal_talks }
		}
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_applied_intercommunal_talks
		add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_CYP_1970_communal_tension = -5 }
		clamp_variable = { var = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_communal_tension min = 0 max = 100 }
		add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_CYP_1970_settlement_progress = 10 }
		clamp_variable = { var = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_settlement_progress min = 0 max = 100 }
	}
}

COLDWAR_CYP_1970_send_intercommunal_talks = {
	COLDWAR_CYP_1970_grant_intercommunal_talks = yes
}

COLDWAR_CYP_1970_complete_intercommunal_talks = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_registered_intercommunal_talks }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_CYP_1970_current_cost = gdp_total }
		multiply_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_CYP_1970_current_cost = 0.005 }
		if = {
			limit = {
				original_tag = CYP
				IMP_is_1970_scenario = yes
				OR = { is_ai = no AND = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_dedicated_historical_ai NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_human_seat_reserved } } }
				OR = {
					AND = {
						has_completed_focus = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_republic_at_ten
						NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_pending_completion_republic_at_ten }
						has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_applied_republic_at_ten
					}
				}
				check_variable = { gdp_total > 0 }
				check_variable = { var = treasury value = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_current_cost compare = greater_than_or_equals }
			}
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_registered_intercommunal_talks
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_pending_completion_intercommunal_talks
			set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_current_cost }
			multiply_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -1 }
			modify_treasury_effect = yes
			COLDWAR_CYP_1970_send_intercommunal_talks = yes
		}
		else = {
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_pending_completion_intercommunal_talks
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_programmes_pending
		}
	}
}

		if = {
			limit = {
				original_tag = CYP
				IMP_is_1970_scenario = yes
				OR = { is_ai = no AND = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_dedicated_historical_ai NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_human_seat_reserved } } }
				OR = {
					AND = {
						has_completed_focus = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_republic_at_ten
						NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_pending_completion_republic_at_ten }
						has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_applied_republic_at_ten
					}
				}
			}
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_registered_command_review
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_pending_completion_command_review

			COLDWAR_CYP_1970_send_command_review = yes
		}
		else = {

		}
	}

COLDWAR_CYP_1970_send_safe_passage = {

	country_event = { id = COLDWAR_CYP_1970.3003 days = 1 }
}

COLDWAR_CYP_1970_complete_safe_passage = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_registered_safe_passage }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_CYP_1970_current_cost = gdp_total }
		multiply_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_CYP_1970_current_cost = 0.01 }
		if = {
			limit = {
				original_tag = CYP
				IMP_is_1970_scenario = yes
				OR = { is_ai = no AND = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_dedicated_historical_ai NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_human_seat_reserved } } }
				OR = {
					AND = {
						has_completed_focus = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_intercommunal_talks
						NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_pending_completion_intercommunal_talks }
						has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_applied_intercommunal_talks
					}
				}
				check_variable = { gdp_total > 0 }
				check_variable = { var = treasury value = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_current_cost compare = greater_than_or_equals }
			}
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_registered_safe_passage

		multiply_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_CYP_1970_current_cost = 0.015 }
		if = {
			limit = {
				original_tag = CYP
				IMP_is_1970_scenario = yes
				OR = { is_ai = no AND = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_dedicated_historical_ai NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_human_seat_reserved } } }

				has_war = no
				NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_unresolved_reprisals }

				original_tag = CYP
				IMP_is_1970_scenario = yes
				OR = { is_ai = no AND = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_dedicated_historical_ai NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_human_seat_reserved } } }
				check_variable = { gdp_total > 0 }
				check_variable = { var = treasury value = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_current_cost compare = greater_than_or_equals }
			}
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_registered_development_survey
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_pending_completion_development_survey
			set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_current_cost }
			multiply_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -1 }
			modify_treasury_effect = yes
			COLDWAR_CYP_1970_send_development_survey = yes
		}
		else = {
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_pending_completion_development_survey
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_programmes_pending
		}
	}

			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_pending_completion_limassol_port
			set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_current_cost }
			multiply_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -1 }
			modify_treasury_effect = yes
			COLDWAR_CYP_1970_send_limassol_port = yes
		}
		else = {

COLDWAR_CYP_1970_complete_credit_question = {

		limit = {
			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_registered_credit_question }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_CYP_1970_current_cost = gdp_total }
		multiply_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_CYP_1970_current_cost = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = {
				original_tag = CYP
				IMP_is_1970_scenario = yes
				OR = { is_ai = no AND = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_dedicated_historical_ai NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_human_seat_reserved } } }
				OR = {
					AND = {
						has_completed_focus = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_famagusta_port
						NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_pending_completion_famagusta_port }
						has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_applied_famagusta_port
					}
					AND = {
						has_completed_focus = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_limassol_port
						NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_pending_completion_limassol_port }
						has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_applied_limassol_port
					}
					AND = {
						has_completed_focus = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_vocational_schools
						NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_pending_completion_vocational_schools }
						has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_applied_vocational_schools
					}
				}
			}
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_registered_credit_question
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_pending_completion_credit_question

			COLDWAR_CYP_1970_send_credit_question = yes
		}
		else = {
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_pending_completion_credit_question
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_programmes_pending
		}
	}
}

		multiply_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_CYP_1970_current_cost = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = {
				original_tag = CYP
				IMP_is_1970_scenario = yes
				OR = { is_ai = no AND = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_dedicated_historical_ai NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_human_seat_reserved } } }
			}
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_registered_guard_review
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_pending_completion_guard_review

			COLDWAR_CYP_1970_send_guard_review = yes
		}
		else = {
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_pending_completion_guard_review
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_programmes_pending
		}
	}
}

COLDWAR_CYP_1970_send_greek_mission = {
	clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_reply_GRE_greek_mission
	clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_declined_greek_mission
	set_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_pending_GRE_greek_mission
	set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_live_GRE_greek_mission days = 90 value = 1 }
	GRE = {
		country_event = { id = COLDWAR_CYP_1970.1156 days = 1 }
	}
	set_variable = { COLDWAR_CYP_1970_offer_instance_greek_mission = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_crisis_instance }
}

COLDWAR_CYP_1970_complete_greek_mission = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_registered_greek_mission }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_CYP_1970_current_cost = gdp_total }
		multiply_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_CYP_1970_current_cost = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = {
				original_tag = CYP
				IMP_is_1970_scenario = yes
				OR = { is_ai = no AND = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_dedicated_historical_ai NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_human_seat_reserved } } }
				country_exists = GRE
				OR = {
					AND = {
						has_completed_focus = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_training_standards
						NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_pending_completion_training_standards }
						has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_applied_training_standards
					}
				}
			}
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_registered_greek_mission
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_pending_completion_greek_mission

			COLDWAR_CYP_1970_send_greek_mission = yes
		}
		else = {
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_pending_completion_greek_mission
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_programmes_pending
		}
	}
}

					AND = {
						has_completed_focus = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_nonaligned_contacts
						NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_pending_completion_nonaligned_contacts }
						has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_applied_nonaligned_contacts
					}
				}
				check_variable = { gdp_total > 0 }
				check_variable = { var = treasury value = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_current_cost compare = greater_than_or_equals }
			}
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_registered_western_association
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_pending_completion_western_association
			set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_current_cost }
			multiply_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -1 }
			modify_treasury_effect = yes
			COLDWAR_CYP_1970_send_western_association = yes
		}
		else = {
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_pending_completion_western_association
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_programmes_pending
		}
	}

COLDWAR_CYP_1970_complete_enosis_agreement = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_registered_enosis_agreement }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_CYP_1970_current_cost = gdp_total }
		multiply_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_CYP_1970_current_cost = 0.01 }
		if = {
			limit = {
				original_tag = CYP
				IMP_is_1970_scenario = yes
				OR = { is_ai = no AND = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_dedicated_historical_ai NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_human_seat_reserved } } }
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_tc_community_assent
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_tc_enosis_assent
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_guarantees_revised
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_bases_agreement
				has_war = no
				controls_state = 145
				controls_state = 146
				NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_independence_settled }
				country_exists = GRE
				country_exists = TUR
				country_exists = ENG
				OR = {
					AND = {
						has_completed_focus = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_enosis_debate
						NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_pending_completion_enosis_debate }
						has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_applied_enosis_debate
					}
				}
				check_variable = { gdp_total > 0 }
				check_variable = { var = treasury value = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_current_cost compare = greater_than_or_equals }
			}
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_registered_enosis_agreement
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_pending_completion_enosis_agreement
			set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_current_cost }
			multiply_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -1 }
			modify_treasury_effect = yes
			COLDWAR_CYP_1970_send_enosis_agreement = yes
		}
		else = {
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_pending_completion_enosis_agreement
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_programmes_pending
		}
	}
}

	COLDWAR_CYP_1970_grant_temporary_housing = yes
}

COLDWAR_CYP_1970_complete_temporary_housing = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_registered_temporary_housing }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_CYP_1970_current_cost = gdp_total }
		multiply_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_CYP_1970_current_cost = 0.01 }
		if = {
			limit = {
				original_tag = CYP
				IMP_is_1970_scenario = yes
				OR = { is_ai = no AND = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_dedicated_historical_ai NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_human_seat_reserved } } }
				OR = {
					AND = {
						has_completed_focus = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_emergency_relief
						NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_pending_completion_emergency_relief }
						has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_applied_emergency_relief
					}
				}
				OR = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_displacement_active has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_actual_partition }
				check_variable = { gdp_total > 0 }
				check_variable = { var = treasury value = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_current_cost compare = greater_than_or_equals }
			}
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_registered_temporary_housing
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_pending_completion_temporary_housing
			set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_current_cost }
			multiply_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -1 }
			modify_treasury_effect = yes
			COLDWAR_CYP_1970_send_temporary_housing = yes
		}
		else = {
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_pending_completion_temporary_housing
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_programmes_pending
		}
	}

		145 = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					is_owned_by = CYP
					is_controlled_by = CYP

				}
				remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_shattered_communities }

				}

		limit = {
			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_applied_p1_institutions }
		}
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_applied_p1_institutions
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { COLDWAR_CYP_1970_party_reform_credit < 5 }
			}
			set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_CYP_1970_credit_delta = 5 }
			subtract_from_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_CYP_1970_credit_delta = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_party_reform_credit }
			add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_CYP_1970_settlement_progress = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_credit_delta }
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_CYP_1970_party_reform_credit = 5 }
			clamp_variable = { var = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_settlement_progress min = 0 max = 100 }
		}
	}
}

COLDWAR_CYP_1970_complete_p1_finance_review = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_registered_p1_finance_review }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_CYP_1970_current_cost = gdp_total }
		multiply_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_CYP_1970_current_cost = 0.005 }
		if = {
			limit = {
				original_tag = CYP
				IMP_is_1970_scenario = yes
				OR = { is_ai = no AND = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_dedicated_historical_ai NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_human_seat_reserved } } }
				check_variable = { ruling_party = 1 }
				OR = {
					AND = {
						has_completed_focus = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_p1_project_a1
						NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_pending_completion_p1_project_a1 }
						has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_applied_p1_project_a1
					}
					AND = {
						has_completed_focus = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_p1_project_a2
						NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_pending_completion_p1_project_a2 }
						has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_applied_p1_project_a2
					}
					AND = {
						has_completed_focus = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_p1_project_b1
						NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_pending_completion_p1_project_b1 }
						has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_applied_p1_project_b1
					}
					AND = {
						has_completed_focus = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_p1_project_b2
						NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_pending_completion_p1_project_b2 }
						has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_applied_p1_project_b2
					}
				}
				check_variable = { gdp_total > 0 }
				check_variable = { var = treasury value = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_current_cost compare = greater_than_or_equals }
			}
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_registered_p1_finance_review
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_pending_completion_p1_finance_review
			set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_current_cost }
			multiply_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -1 }
			modify_treasury_effect = yes
			COLDWAR_CYP_1970_send_p1_finance_review = yes
		}
		else = {
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_pending_completion_p1_finance_review
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_programmes_pending
		}
	}
}

			set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_current_cost }

			modify_treasury_effect = yes
			COLDWAR_CYP_1970_send_p1_national_programme = yes
		}
		else = {
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_pending_completion_p1_national_programme
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_programmes_pending
		}
	}

	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_applied_p2_second_a }
		}
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_applied_p2_second_a
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { COLDWAR_CYP_1970_party_reform_credit < 10 }
			}
			set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_CYP_1970_credit_delta = 10 }
			subtract_from_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_CYP_1970_credit_delta = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_party_reform_credit }
			add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_CYP_1970_settlement_progress = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_credit_delta }
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_CYP_1970_party_reform_credit = 10 }
			clamp_variable = { var = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_settlement_progress min = 0 max = 100 }
		}
	}
}

				original_tag = CYP
				IMP_is_1970_scenario = yes

				check_variable = { ruling_party = 2 }
				OR = {
					AND = {
						has_completed_focus = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_p2_settlement
						NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_pending_completion_p2_settlement }
						has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_applied_p2_settlement
					}
				}

			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_pending_completion_p2_economic_mandate

			multiply_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -1 }

			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_registered_p2_finance_b
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_pending_completion_p2_finance_b
			set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_current_cost }
			multiply_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -1 }
			modify_treasury_effect = yes
			COLDWAR_CYP_1970_send_p2_finance_b = yes

		else = {

			COLDWAR_CYP_1970_send_p3_follow_b = yes
		}
		else = {
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_pending_completion_p3_follow_b
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_programmes_pending
		}
	}
}

COLDWAR_CYP_1970_grant_p3_institutions = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_applied_p3_institutions }
		}
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_applied_p3_institutions
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { COLDWAR_CYP_1970_party_reform_credit < 5 }
			}
			set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_CYP_1970_credit_delta = 5 }
			subtract_from_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_CYP_1970_credit_delta = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_party_reform_credit }
			add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_CYP_1970_settlement_progress = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_credit_delta }
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_CYP_1970_party_reform_credit = 5 }
			clamp_variable = { var = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_settlement_progress min = 0 max = 100 }
		}
	}
}

COLDWAR_CYP_1970_send_p3_institutions = {
	COLDWAR_CYP_1970_grant_p3_institutions = yes
}

COLDWAR_CYP_1970_complete_p3_institutions = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_registered_p3_institutions }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_CYP_1970_current_cost = gdp_total }
		multiply_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_CYP_1970_current_cost = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = {
				original_tag = CYP
				IMP_is_1970_scenario = yes
				OR = { is_ai = no AND = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_dedicated_historical_ai NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_human_seat_reserved } } }
				check_variable = { ruling_party = 3 }
				OR = {
					AND = {
						has_completed_focus = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_p3_follow_a
						NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_pending_completion_p3_follow_a }
						has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_applied_p3_follow_a
					}
					AND = {
						has_completed_focus = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_p3_follow_b
						NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_pending_completion_p3_follow_b }
						has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_applied_p3_follow_b
					}
				}
			}
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_registered_p3_institutions
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_pending_completion_p3_institutions

			COLDWAR_CYP_1970_send_p3_institutions = yes
		}
		else = {
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_pending_completion_p3_institutions
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_programmes_pending
		}
	}
}

COLDWAR_CYP_1970_complete_p3_economic_mandate = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_registered_p3_economic_mandate }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_CYP_1970_current_cost = gdp_total }
		multiply_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_CYP_1970_current_cost = 0.01 }
		if = {
			limit = {
				original_tag = CYP
				IMP_is_1970_scenario = yes
				OR = { is_ai = no AND = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_dedicated_historical_ai NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_human_seat_reserved } } }
				check_variable = { ruling_party = 3 }
				OR = {
					AND = {
						has_completed_focus = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_p3_settlement
						NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_pending_completion_p3_settlement }
						has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_applied_p3_settlement
					}
				}
				check_variable = { gdp_total > 0 }
				check_variable = { var = treasury value = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_current_cost compare = greater_than_or_equals }
			}
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_registered_p3_economic_mandate
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_pending_completion_p3_economic_mandate
			set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_current_cost }
			multiply_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -1 }
			modify_treasury_effect = yes
			COLDWAR_CYP_1970_send_p3_economic_mandate = yes
		}
		else = {
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_pending_completion_p3_economic_mandate
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_programmes_pending
		}
	}
}

}

COLDWAR_CYP_1970_complete_p3_finance_review = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_registered_p3_finance_review }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_CYP_1970_current_cost = gdp_total }
		multiply_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_CYP_1970_current_cost = 0.005 }
		if = {
			limit = {
				original_tag = CYP
				IMP_is_1970_scenario = yes
				OR = { is_ai = no AND = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_dedicated_historical_ai NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_human_seat_reserved } } }
				check_variable = { ruling_party = 3 }
				OR = {
					AND = {
						has_completed_focus = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_p3_project_a1
						NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_pending_completion_p3_project_a1 }
						has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_applied_p3_project_a1
					}
					AND = {
						has_completed_focus = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_p3_project_a2
						NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_pending_completion_p3_project_a2 }
						has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_applied_p3_project_a2
					}
					AND = {
						has_completed_focus = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_p3_project_b1
						NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_pending_completion_p3_project_b1 }
						has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_applied_p3_project_b1
					}
					AND = {
						has_completed_focus = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_p3_project_b2
						NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_pending_completion_p3_project_b2 }
						has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_applied_p3_project_b2
					}
				}
				check_variable = { gdp_total > 0 }
				check_variable = { var = treasury value = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_current_cost compare = greater_than_or_equals }
			}
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_registered_p3_finance_review
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_pending_completion_p3_finance_review
			set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_current_cost }
			multiply_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -1 }
			modify_treasury_effect = yes
			COLDWAR_CYP_1970_send_p3_finance_review = yes
		}
		else = {
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_pending_completion_p3_finance_review
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_programmes_pending
		}
	}
}

	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_registered_p4_organisation }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_CYP_1970_current_cost = gdp_total }
		multiply_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_CYP_1970_current_cost = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = {
				original_tag = CYP
				IMP_is_1970_scenario = yes
				OR = { is_ai = no AND = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_dedicated_historical_ai NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_human_seat_reserved } } }
				check_variable = { ruling_party = 4 }
				OR = {
					AND = {
						has_completed_focus = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_p4_mandate
						NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_pending_completion_p4_mandate }
						has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_applied_p4_mandate
					}
				}
			}
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_registered_p4_organisation
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_pending_completion_p4_organisation

			COLDWAR_CYP_1970_send_p4_organisation = yes
		}
		else = {
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_pending_completion_p4_organisation

		}
	}

		limit = {
			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_registered_p4_first_a }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_CYP_1970_current_cost = gdp_total }
		multiply_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_CYP_1970_current_cost = 0.005 }
		if = {
			limit = {
				original_tag = CYP
				IMP_is_1970_scenario = yes
				OR = { is_ai = no AND = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_dedicated_historical_ai NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_human_seat_reserved } } }
				check_variable = { ruling_party = 4 }
				OR = {
					AND = {
						has_completed_focus = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_p4_organisation
						NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_pending_completion_p4_organisation }
						has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_applied_p4_organisation
					}
				}
				check_variable = { gdp_total > 0 }
				check_variable = { var = treasury value = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_current_cost compare = greater_than_or_equals }
			}
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_registered_p4_first_a
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_pending_completion_p4_first_a
			set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_current_cost }
			multiply_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -1 }
			modify_treasury_effect = yes
			COLDWAR_CYP_1970_send_p4_first_a = yes
		}
		else = {
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_pending_completion_p4_first_a
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_programmes_pending
		}
	}

	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_registered_p4_economic_a }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_CYP_1970_current_cost = gdp_total }
		multiply_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_CYP_1970_current_cost = 0.015 }
		if = {
			limit = {
				original_tag = CYP
				IMP_is_1970_scenario = yes
				OR = { is_ai = no AND = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_dedicated_historical_ai NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_human_seat_reserved } } }
				check_variable = { ruling_party = 4 }
				OR = {
					AND = {
						has_completed_focus = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_p4_economic_mandate
						NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_pending_completion_p4_economic_mandate }
						has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_applied_p4_economic_mandate
					}
				}
				check_variable = { gdp_total > 0 }
				check_variable = { var = treasury value = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_current_cost compare = greater_than_or_equals }
			}
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_registered_p4_economic_a
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_pending_completion_p4_economic_a
			set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_current_cost }
			multiply_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -1 }
			modify_treasury_effect = yes
			COLDWAR_CYP_1970_send_p4_economic_a = yes
		}
		else = {
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_pending_completion_p4_economic_a
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_programmes_pending
		}
	}
}

				OR = { is_ai = no AND = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_dedicated_historical_ai NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_human_seat_reserved } } }
				check_variable = { ruling_party = 4 }
				OR = {
					AND = {
						has_completed_focus = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_p4_finance_a
						NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_pending_completion_p4_finance_a }
						has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_applied_p4_finance_a
					}
				}
			}
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_registered_p4_finance_a_follow
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_pending_completion_p4_finance_a_follow

}

COLDWAR_CYP_1970_complete_p4_social_investment = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_registered_p4_social_investment }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_CYP_1970_current_cost = gdp_total }
		multiply_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_CYP_1970_current_cost = 0.01 }
		if = {
			limit = {
				original_tag = CYP
				IMP_is_1970_scenario = yes
				OR = { is_ai = no AND = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_dedicated_historical_ai NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_human_seat_reserved } } }
				check_variable = { ruling_party = 4 }
				OR = {
					AND = {
						has_completed_focus = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_p4_finance_a_follow
						NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_pending_completion_p4_finance_a_follow }
						has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_applied_p4_finance_a_follow
					}
					AND = {
						has_completed_focus = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_p4_finance_b_follow
						NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_pending_completion_p4_finance_b_follow }
						has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_applied_p4_finance_b_follow
					}
				}
				check_variable = { gdp_total > 0 }
				check_variable = { var = treasury value = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_current_cost compare = greater_than_or_equals }
			}
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_registered_p4_social_investment
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_pending_completion_p4_social_investment
			set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_current_cost }
			multiply_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -1 }
			modify_treasury_effect = yes
			COLDWAR_CYP_1970_send_p4_social_investment = yes
		}
		else = {
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_pending_completion_p4_social_investment
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_programmes_pending
		}
	}
}

			subtract_from_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_CYP_1970_credit_delta = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_party_reform_credit }
			add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_CYP_1970_settlement_progress = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_credit_delta }
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_CYP_1970_party_reform_credit = 5 }
			clamp_variable = { var = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_settlement_progress min = 0 max = 100 }
		}
	}

				check_variable = { var = treasury value = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_current_cost compare = greater_than_or_equals }
			}
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_registered_p20_institutions
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_pending_completion_p20_institutions
			set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_current_cost }
			multiply_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -1 }
			modify_treasury_effect = yes
			COLDWAR_CYP_1970_send_p20_institutions = yes
		}
		else = {
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_pending_completion_p20_institutions
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_programmes_pending
		}
	}

COLDWAR_CYP_1970_complete_p20_finance_review = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_registered_p20_finance_review }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_CYP_1970_current_cost = gdp_total }
		multiply_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_CYP_1970_current_cost = 0.005 }
		if = {
			limit = {
				original_tag = CYP
				IMP_is_1970_scenario = yes
				OR = { is_ai = no AND = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_dedicated_historical_ai NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_human_seat_reserved } } }
				check_variable = { ruling_party = 20 }
				OR = {
					AND = {
						has_completed_focus = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_p20_project_a1
						NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_pending_completion_p20_project_a1 }
						has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_applied_p20_project_a1
					}
					AND = {
						has_completed_focus = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_p20_project_a2
						NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_pending_completion_p20_project_a2 }
						has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_applied_p20_project_a2
					}
					AND = {
						has_completed_focus = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_p20_project_b1
						NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_pending_completion_p20_project_b1 }
						has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_applied_p20_project_b1
					}
					AND = {
						has_completed_focus = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_p20_project_b2
						NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_pending_completion_p20_project_b2 }
						has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_applied_p20_project_b2
					}
				}
				check_variable = { gdp_total > 0 }
				check_variable = { var = treasury value = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_current_cost compare = greater_than_or_equals }
			}
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_registered_p20_finance_review
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_pending_completion_p20_finance_review
			set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_current_cost }
			multiply_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -1 }
			modify_treasury_effect = yes
			COLDWAR_CYP_1970_send_p20_finance_review = yes
		}
		else = {
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_pending_completion_p20_finance_review
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_programmes_pending
		}
	}
}

			limit = {
				original_tag = CYP
				IMP_is_1970_scenario = yes
				OR = { is_ai = no AND = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_dedicated_historical_ai NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_human_seat_reserved } } }
				OR = {
					check_variable = { ruling_party = 21 }
					check_variable = { ruling_party = 22 }
				}
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_coup_regime_active
				date > 1970.12.31
				OR = {
					AND = {
						has_completed_focus = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_p22_organisation
						NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_pending_completion_p22_organisation }
						has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_applied_p22_organisation
					}
				}
			}
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_registered_p22_first_a
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_pending_completion_p22_first_a

			COLDWAR_CYP_1970_send_p22_first_a = yes
		}
		else = {

			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_programmes_pending
		}

			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_registered_p22_first_b }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_CYP_1970_current_cost = gdp_total }
		multiply_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_CYP_1970_current_cost = 0.01 }
		if = {
			limit = {
				original_tag = CYP
				IMP_is_1970_scenario = yes
				OR = { is_ai = no AND = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_dedicated_historical_ai NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_human_seat_reserved } } }
				OR = {
					check_variable = { ruling_party = 21 }
					check_variable = { ruling_party = 22 }
				}
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_coup_regime_active
				date > 1970.12.31
				OR = {
					AND = {
						has_completed_focus = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_p22_organisation
						NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_pending_completion_p22_organisation }
						has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_applied_p22_organisation
					}
				}
				check_variable = { gdp_total > 0 }
				check_variable = { var = treasury value = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_current_cost compare = greater_than_or_equals }
			}
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_registered_p22_first_b
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_pending_completion_p22_first_b
			set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_current_cost }
			multiply_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -1 }
			modify_treasury_effect = yes
			COLDWAR_CYP_1970_send_p22_first_b = yes
		}
		else = {
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_pending_completion_p22_first_b
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_programmes_pending
		}
	}

				OR = { is_ai = no AND = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_dedicated_historical_ai NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_human_seat_reserved } } }

						has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_applied_p22_economic_mandate
					}

		if = {
			limit = {
				original_tag = CYP
				IMP_is_1970_scenario = yes
				OR = { is_ai = no AND = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_dedicated_historical_ai NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_human_seat_reserved } } }
				check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_relief_stage value = 1 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
				OR = {
					AND = {
						has_completed_focus = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_tc_cooperative_credit
						NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_pending_completion_tc_cooperative_credit }
						has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_applied_tc_cooperative_credit
					}
					AND = {

						NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_pending_completion_tc_mixed_workshops }
						has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_applied_tc_mixed_workshops
					}
					AND = {

						NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_pending_completion_tc_business_licences }
						has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_applied_tc_business_licences

						NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_pending_completion_tc_postwar_admin }
						has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_applied_tc_postwar_admin
					}
				}
				check_variable = { gdp_total > 0 }
				check_variable = { var = treasury value = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_current_cost compare = greater_than_or_equals }
			}
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_registered_tc_returns
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_pending_completion_tc_returns
			set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_current_cost }
			multiply_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -1 }
			modify_treasury_effect = yes
			COLDWAR_CYP_1970_send_tc_returns = yes
		}
		else = {
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_pending_completion_tc_returns
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_programmes_pending
		}
	}

			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_registered_tc_beyond_partition }
		}

		multiply_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_CYP_1970_current_cost = 0.015 }
		if = {
			limit = {
				original_tag = CYP
				IMP_is_1970_scenario = yes
				OR = { is_ai = no AND = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_dedicated_historical_ai NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_human_seat_reserved } } }
				has_war = no
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_tc_community_assent
				NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_unresolved_reprisals }
				country_exists = TUR
				country_exists = GRE
				country_exists = ENG
				OR = {
					AND = {
						has_completed_focus = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_tc_returns
						NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_pending_completion_tc_returns }
						has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_applied_tc_returns
					}
					AND = {
						has_completed_focus = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_tc_civilian_access
						NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_pending_completion_tc_civilian_access }
						has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_applied_tc_civilian_access
					}
					AND = {
						has_completed_focus = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_tc_sovereignty_leverage
						NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_pending_completion_tc_sovereignty_leverage }
						has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_applied_tc_sovereignty_leverage
					}
				}
				check_variable = { gdp_total > 0 }
				check_variable = { var = treasury value = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_current_cost compare = greater_than_or_equals }
			}
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_registered_tc_beyond_partition
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_pending_completion_tc_beyond_partition
			set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_current_cost }
			multiply_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -1 }

			COLDWAR_CYP_1970_send_tc_beyond_partition = yes

	set_variable = { COLDWAR_CYP_1970_offer_instance_war_geneva = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_crisis_instance }

COLDWAR_CYP_1970_complete_war_geneva = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_registered_war_geneva }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_CYP_1970_current_cost = gdp_total }
		multiply_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_CYP_1970_current_cost = 0.005 }
		if = {
			limit = {
				original_tag = CYP
				IMP_is_1970_scenario = yes
				OR = { is_ai = no AND = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_dedicated_historical_ai NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_human_seat_reserved } } }
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_first_intervention_phase
				country_exists = GRE
				country_exists = TUR
				country_exists = ENG
				check_variable = { gdp_total > 0 }
				check_variable = { var = treasury value = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_current_cost compare = greater_than_or_equals }
			}
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_registered_war_geneva
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_pending_completion_war_geneva
			set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_current_cost }
			multiply_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -1 }
			modify_treasury_effect = yes
			COLDWAR_CYP_1970_send_war_geneva = yes
		}
		else = {
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_pending_completion_war_geneva
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_programmes_pending
		}
	}
}

COLDWAR_CYP_1970_sync_milestones = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_coup_attempt_resolved
			NOT = { has_completed_focus = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_war_putsch }
		}
		complete_national_focus = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_war_putsch
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_guarantor_response_recorded
			NOT = { has_completed_focus = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_war_guarantors }
		}
		complete_national_focus = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_war_guarantors
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_constitutional_government_restored
			NOT = { has_completed_focus = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_war_restore }
		}
		complete_national_focus = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_war_restore
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_renewed_hostilities_decided
			NOT = { has_completed_focus = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_war_august }
		}
		complete_national_focus = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_war_august
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_final_settlement_implemented
			NOT = { has_completed_focus = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_war_monitored_settlement }
